player_prompt.intro:
Ami Player {player_id} ({role}) aakar {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies khelnaame.
- Pratyek round, [heads] ba [tails] (ba [h], [t]) jomaao.
- Jodi tomaar pasand tomaar pratidwandwiir pasandke saath milaay, tahale Player 0 oi round jeetbe; anyatha Player 1 jeetbe.
Tomaar pasandke saath '[heads]' ba '[tails]' formatme jawaab dao.

message.round_match: ᱯᱞᱮᱭᱟᱨ 0 ᱫᱚ {choice0} ᱮ ᱠᱩᱨᱩᱢᱩᱴᱩ ᱞᱮᱜᱤᱭᱟ; ᱯᱞᱮᱭᱟᱨ 1 ᱫᱚ {choice1} ᱮ ᱠᱩᱨᱩᱢᱩᱴᱩ ᱞᱮᱜᱤᱭᱟ. ᱢᱮᱪ -> ᱯᱞᱮᱭᱟᱨ 0 ᱡᱤᱛᱠᱟᱨ ᱮᱱᱟ
